runtime_uncertainties: The fixed marked_crosswalk control can support crosswalk alternatives; intersection alternative requires connected native intersection geometry in the same cell.
Sufficient space and obstructing passage have no supplied numeric legal cutoff; raw geometry and motion do not alone resolve judgment.
No physical blocker, exact runner, finalizer, source-bound compatibility or saved audit has yet been implemented.
law_text: No driver shall enter an intersection or a marked crosswalk unless there is sufficient space on the other side of the intersection or crosswalk to accommodate the vehicle he is operating without obstructing the passage of other vehicles or pedestrians, notwithstanding any traffic-control signal indication to proceed.

alternatives_and_boundaries: Intersection entry and marked-crosswalk entry are alternatives; fixed marked_crosswalk control may support both if geometry is present.
Compare enough downstream accommodation versus blocked downstream space, measuring full vehicle body, actual passage obstruction and upstream stop/entry.
Proceed signal does not waive the space condition; include a proceed indication while varying downstream clearance.
Sufficient space and obstruction are judgment phrases without supplied numeric cutoffs.

evidence_review.method: Read the frozen evidence inventory; zero accepted recordings are listed, so no accommodation or obstruction fact can be reused.
